footer.tagline: A pattern-matching tool for freelancers, founders, and anyone about to sign something they didn’t write.
footer.disclaimerBody: This tool flags clauses that differ from common industry norms; it does not provide legal opinions and cannot replace a qualified attorney. Contract text you submit is sent to the AI provider you select for analysis. Decisions to sign, negotiate, or walk away are yours and yours alone.

hero.subtitle: Paste any contract. In seconds, we surface the aggressive clauses, compare them to industry norms, and draft a counter-agreement your lawyer can edit.

coverage.title: Nine categories. Every clause.
coverage.subtitle: Each scan checks the patterns lawyers usually flag, plus the modern ones they don’t yet — AI-training rights, exclusivity creep, data ownership.

ip.title: Intellectual Property

counter.subtitle: One click drafts a revised contract that addresses every finding — and a clean redline diff. Download both as PDFs. Hand them to your lawyer, hand them to your counterparty, hand them to yourself.
counter.bullet1: Revised PDF in plain prose, ready to print
counter.bullet2: Redline PDF with line-by-line additions and removals
counter.bullet3: Pick a stronger model just for the draft (Opus, GPT-4o, Gemini Pro)
counter.bullet4: Disclaimer stamped on every page — never legal advice

providers.title: Bring your own intelligence.
providers.subtitle: Run the scan against Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, or a local Ollama model. Pick the cheapest one for triage and a heavier one for the draft. Your text only goes where you choose.
